jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

About The Airwallex Intern Program

Gain hands-on experience through owning your own project end to end
Benefit from personal mentorship by industry leading technologists
Rare software engineering intern experience where you are hands-on with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted workflows
Join a cohort experience that fosters knowledge sharing, networking and soft skill development
Many of our Interns receive an Airwallex Graduate role at intern program completion We are looking for talented, curious and determined individuals to join our 12-week Software Engineering Intern Program commencing in May 2027.

About The Team

The Engineering team at Airwallex is a diverse group of innovators, builders, and problem solvers, driven by a mission to empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. We thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, where we're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the financial technology space.

As a team, we value technical craftsmanship, continuous learning and a strong sense of ownership, and we believe modern engineers should know how to work effectively with AI. We build scalable, reliable and secure products that empower businesses to grow without borders, and we want interns who are excited to explore LLM-powered tools thoughtfully, apply sound engineering judgement, and stay current with the fast-moving AI landscape.

What You'll Do

As an intern, you will be given an exciting and challenging project that you'll start in week 1. You'll join our structured Intern Program, be set up with a mentor and manager to make sure you have the best experience and that you are encouraged and supported to contribute. Most importantly, we want you to feel part of the team and learn lots while you are working with us!

Our leaders welcome all Airwallex people to contribute to our roadmap and to constantly challenge the processes that we build our platforms through. You'll get the opportunity to learn and apply best-practice software engineering, focusing on strong software engineering fundamentals and pragmatism from our engineers.

You will learn how AI can enhance strong engineering by using LLM tools for research, prototyping, debugging, testing and documentation, while applying critical judgement and strong fundamentals. Working on ambitious goals with a modern stack including Kotlin, Kafka, Kubernetes and React, you will help deliver simple, scalable solutions while exploring new models and tooling with your team.

Intern Program structure

12 weeks over the Singapore University summer break (start early May to late Jul)
1st week in a structured induction
3 Program Review / Check-Ins across the 12 week program
1 Intern scoped Project to own end to end
1 Project Showcase to present back to our Teams on what you built

About You

You can think on your feet - with knowledge of building platforms which resolve fast paced, ever changing success measures
You are a team player - you enjoy working in a collaborative, innovative and customer first environment
You are naturally curious - always asking why to better understand our customer needs
You are a passionate problem solver - You love digging deep and brainstorming with colleagues in order to come up with the best solution for a problem
You are excited about AI - You are enthusiastic about how AI is transforming software engineering and enjoy exploring new tools and models, applying them thoughtfully and responsibly to improve the way you build software

Eligibility Requirements

Penultimate year or Final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree, at any stage in your PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
Computing and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Fundamentals
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Desire to learn and grow with Airwallex as a technologist

Life at Airwallex as an Intern

💸 Competitive rewards: Industry-leading salaries and benefits

🥗 On-site snacks & drinks, lunch credits

🎂 Enjoy a paid day off on your birthday to celebrate YOU

🏢 Prime location: Centrally located office for easy access

Application & Assessment process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We'll keep you updated throughout the process, and appreciate your patience while we carefully review every application.

The Recruitment Process Includes

Application submission including your current resume and academic transcript
Online technical assessment
Talent screen
Live Code Interview
Hiring Manager interview

About

As part of the interview process, we are interested not only in your coding fundamentals, but also in how you think about using AI in engineering. Depending on the stage, we may assess:

How you approach problem solving with and without AI assistance
Your ability to evaluate, refine or challenge AI-generated suggestions
Your curiosity about new models, tools and practical use cases

We are not looking for candidates who simply use AI tools. We are looking for future engineers who can use them thoughtfully, critically and effectively.

Requirements:
Please provide us with the latest PDF copies of your transcript and CV outlining when you finish your studies when applying

Applications close: 18 Sep 2026 2359 SGT

If the career website link does not work, please use this application link instead: Alternative application link

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: ETL Developer
jobs.description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator. 

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004. 

Virtuosi is a team of experts – people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication.

At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

About The Position

We are looking for an ETL Developer to join our team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data integration solutions. You will be responsible for building robust ETL pipelines, integrating data from multiple sources, and delivering high-quality datasets that support business intelligence, reporting, and analytics across the organization.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, including APIs and other programmatic integrations.
Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines to support business intelligence and reporting initiatives.
Connect to diverse data sources, import, cleanse, and transform data into reliable, business-ready datasets.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into efficient data models and ETL solutions.
Produce clear technical documentation, including solution designs, data flows, and project documentation.
Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, prototyping, and implementation activities.
Work with Microsoft technologies such as Azure, SQL Server, SQL Data Warehouse, and Visual Studio to build and support data solutions.
Support DevOps initiatives by automating deployment processes and contributing to cloud migration efforts.
Develop end-to-end business solutions using .NET, C#, Visual Studio, and Microsoft SQL Server.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize ETL workflows to ensure performance, reliability, and data quality.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, or a similar role.
Proven experience in designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines and data integration solutions.
Experience with data preparation, data warehousing, and data gateway technologies.
Hands-on experience with API integrations and data extraction methodologies.
Strong understanding of ETL frameworks, data modelling, database management systems, and OLAP concepts.
Proficiency in writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting complex SQL queries.
Experience with Microsoft technologies such as SQL Server, Azure, SQL Data Warehouse, Visual Studio, .NET, and C#.
Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and cloud migration is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer – App Growth and Performance
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

At Criteo, the CIA team contributes to the broader App initiative and works closely with product and engineering teams across the company to improve and grow Criteo's App product.

Because the App product spans multiple systems and teams, the work is not confined to a single service or component. You will join a small, collaborative squad and work wherever the problem leads: from backend services and APIs to data, tracking, configuration, testing, and observability.

This is not a role where success is measured only by shipping features in one component. You will make ambiguous problems understandable, identify what limits product performance, and turn your findings into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Investigate App performance, reliability, and integration issues, tracing signals across systems to identify root causes.
Use production data, logs, and metrics to explain behavior, validate assumptions, and measure impact.
Turn findings into clear recommendations, including options, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes.
Build and test backend services, APIs, instrumentation, data pipelines, and internal tools to solve complex issues.
Work across backend services, click tracking, app linking and landing, MMP integrations, attribution, measurement, and observability.
Partner with Product, Analytics, Technical Services, Operations, and R&D to connect technical work to business outcomes.
Own topics end to end by identifying gaps, surfacing risks, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery through code reviews and continuous delivery.

Technical environment: C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, APIs, data pipelines, and production observability.

Who You Are:

4+ years of experience building and evolving complex production systems.
Strong backend fundamentals in object-oriented programming, service and API design, testing, and production operations; experience with C#, Java, Python, C++, Scala, or a similar ecosystem.
An excellent troubleshooter who can navigate unfamiliar systems, trace issues across components, and identify root causes.
Comfortable using metrics and production data to validate assumptions and guide technical and product decisions.
Technical depth combined with curiosity about the business, product impact, and customer outcomes.
An interest in the mobile and app ecosystem, including app links, tracking, attribution, privacy, and mobile measurement partners.
An ownership mindset, clear communication, and a commitment to simple, reusable, well-tested code and reliable production systems.

Bonus:

Experience with mobile advertising, app measurement, attribution, or mobile measurement partner integrations.
Front-end development experience with Angular, React, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Experience with observability, production investigations, data analysis, or distributed systems.
Experience translating Product or UX needs into practical technical solutions.

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
jobs.description:
Project description

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Responsibilities

Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.
Manage Fabric-native catalog and discovery functionalities.
Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.
Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.
Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.
Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.
Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.
Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.
Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.
Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.
Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.
Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.
Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.

Skills

Must have

Python,
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),
Microsoft Azure DevOps,
Microsoft Azure Services,
Microsoft Data Fabric,
Network,
IP Routing,
TCP/IP,
CI/CD

Nice to have

Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP-600/DP-700 certifications),
experience in building AI Landing zones,
experience with FabricIO & o365 agents,
C# proficiency, Databricks,
self-driven/self-motivated,
PowerShell.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain industrial applications and services using C#/.NET, Angular, MSSQL, Redis, NATS, and related technologies.
Own solutions end-to-end, from requirement gathering and architecture through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and troubleshooting while remaining responsible for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of the solution.
Develop backend services, APIs, and machine-data integrations using technologies such as MQTT, NATS, OPC-UA, and Kepware.
Design and optimize databases, queries, stored procedures, caching strategies, and production data flows.
Build real-time dashboards, reporting, and monitoring solutions for production KPIs and operational data.
Design reliable systems that handle production realities such as high data volumes, concurrency, connectivity issues, duplicate messages, and out-of-order events.
Troubleshoot issues across frontend, backend, database, messaging, infrastructure, and machine integration layers.
Work directly with operators, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, validate solutions, and improve existing systems.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, CI/CD, automated testing, and production diagnostics.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes using software and AI.
Travel abroad when required for business needs, including project implementation, technical support, collaboration.

Knowledge And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably involving production systems, manufacturing, MES, industrial automation, or machine integration.
Strong C#/.NET skills, including ASP.NET Core, APIs, asynchronous programming, and background services.
Strong Angular and TypeScript development skills.
Strong MSSQL knowledge, including database design, indexing, query optimization, and stored procedures.
Understanding of distributed systems, messaging, caching, concurrency, and event-driven architectures.
Experience with technologies such as NATS, MQTT, OPC-UA, Kepware, or similar industrial integration platforms.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools.
Ability to review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and architectural fit.
Understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, logging, and production troubleshooting.
Strong problem-solving skills across software, database, integration, and manufacturing environments.
Ability to communicate effectively with software teams, controls engineers, process engineers, operators, and business stakeholders.
This is an on-site position at our Izmir Plant in the Aegean Free Zone (ESBAS), Izmir, Türkiye. Remote or hybrid working is not available.

Come join our global, inclusive & diverse team

Our purpose is to improve the quality of life of everyone we touch through our innovative motion systems. We are a truly global team bound together by our shared values. Our culture is built on the diversity, knowledge, skills, creativity, and talents that each employee brings to the company. Our people are our company’s most valuable asset. We are committed to providing an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where employees of different backgrounds feel valued and respected, regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity or religious background. We are committed to inspiring our employees to grow, act with ownership and find fulfilment and meaning in the work they do.
